findings.issue: The A/B/C scenario requires 'termination of A/B within the deadline before C commits' and also allows 55P03 in A as an alternative (145:49; obx:39 and obx:53 say the same). In the 55P03 branch, A rolls back and releases its advisory. B commits and C gets UPDATE and commits. A's external retry can then finish after C, possibly with OutboxLegacyCutoverError after NEW. Taken literally, 'A before C' is wrong for that branch. It is not an impossible oracle: under PostgreSQL, heap_lock_tuple grants SHARE to A without sleeping, so the branch should not occur. But the permitted path has no consistent assertion.
findings.required_change: In 145:47-49 (and in obx:39/53 at the next Architect touch), split the assertion. Without 55P03: A and B commit before C, with no 40P01 and no duplicate. With 55P03: A's first attempt is fully rolled back, B commits before C, and A's retry with the same key ends in LEGACY success before C or OutboxLegacyCutoverError after NEW, with no duplicate effect.

summary: PASS. This was a read-only review: no Git commands, no edits. I read reviews 1 and 2, the corrected OBX contract and prompts 144-146 at HEAD. For A1 §8.1 I used the DETRAN citation in the contract (obx:3/51); I did not open a separate DETRAN file. The one cycle-2 blocker is closed. In the queue where B holds marker SHARE, C only waits for UPDATE and A asks for SHARE, obx:39 now says PostgreSQL can grant A's SHARE immediately. Prompt 145:45-49 requires only completion within the deadline, no 40P01 and no duplicate event or message, with C after A and B. 55P03 is allowed there but not required. The separate variant, where C already holds UPDATE, requires A's FOR SHARE NOWAIT to fail with typed 55P03 (OutboxOwnershipContentionError), full rollback, and a retry with the same key ending in LEGACY success or OutboxLegacyCutoverError after NEW (145:50-53; obx:39). The contract no longer says 'A pode esperar atrás de C'; obx:11 now states that a merely queued UPDATE does not require the failure. The cycle-2 observations are closed. OFS-01 cancels only the unused tail, never re-issues applied numbers, and a repeated cancel is idempotent (146:20-22). OFS-02 requires getSyncBatchReceipt and getSyncItemReceipt to return the original receipt in the tenant, a rejected attempt must not replace it, and a cross-tenant read must fail (146:29-31). Audit sensors go under packages/audit/test/integration/**/*.spec.ts; vitest.int.config.ts includes that path and aliases outbox. Backend sensors follow test/integration/*.integration.spec.ts under backend's single vitest.config.ts, which includes test/**/*.spec.ts and aliases outbox. Backend also hosts the non-strict CTG5/i18n/ratelimit/tenancy regression (145:12-18). Signature has .changeset/signature-trust-dependencies-15.md (minor), @stynx-nyx/health: workspace:* in package.json:37, and pkijs, asn1js and @peculiar/x509 linked in packages/signature/node_modules, plus a health alias in vitest.config.ts. The Inspector write sets are tests and fixtures only, and they do not overlap: signature/test; outbox, data, backend and audit tests; offline-sync/test. postgres.ts is frozen. src, migrations, docs, law, generated files and baselines are excluded. Imports resolve, and the prompts forbid a red that is only a missing module. I found no remaining impossible oracle. One nonblocking wording gap remains: the order assertion for the permitted but practically unreachable 55P03 branch of the A/B/C queue. PASS clears dispatch of the three Inspectors in parallel. It does not attest implementation, tests or conformance.
